subject: Re: Urgent: StellarNet surge - segmented fleet slab assignment
messages:
From: Elaine Ford <elaine.ford@stellarnet.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Cc: ops@stellarnet.com
Date: 2027-09-21T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: Urgent: short-term capacity need for Q4 ramp

Priyom —

Quick background: StellarNet just closed a reseller deal that moves an incremental 250k reqs/day into production starting Oct 1. Our model footprint is heavier than expected and we have a hard SLA commitment to the end customer. We reviewed Dedicated commitments and it looks like we need immediate short-term additional dedicated slices for 6 weeks while we optimize the model and move to a quantized variant.

Can Redwood provide a segmented slab (reserved GPUs) for StellarNet for the Oct 1–Nov 12 window? We need guidance on:
- minimum GPU count you can guarantee
- whether that allocation would be preemptible for higher-priority enterprise deals
- expected unit cost uplift for short-term reservation

I'm attaching our capacity ask spreadsheet and the latest SOW excerpt. This is time-sensitive — can we get a call before EOD PT tomorrow?

Thanks,
Elaine Ford
VP, Platform Ops
StellarNet
Attachments: StellarNet_capacity_request.xlsx; SOW_StellarNet_v2.pdf
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Elaine Ford <elaine.ford@stellarnet.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-09-21T10:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Urgent: short-term capacity need for Q4 ramp

Elaine —

Thanks for the clear ask and the attachments. We can absolutely support an expedited review. Quick answers up front:
- We can offer a segmented slab (dedicated capacity tranche) while your optimization runs — provisional proposals below.
- We will treat this as a "time-limited reserve" with a canary and rollback policy; preemption only if we hit a platform-wide emergency and after notice.
- Pricing: short-term uplift applies (rate sheet SKU: DED-SLAB-ONRAMP), I'll confirm exact numbers once finance runs the quote.

Can you join a 30-min call at 2pm PT today? I want to pull in Laura (ops lead) and Karthik (Dedicated sizing) to walk numbers and risks.

Best,
Priyom Das
Sr. Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-09-21T11:12:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Urgent: StellarNet surge - need fast plan (internal)

Team —

Looping you in after Stella's ask (attached). Meeting at 2pm PT today with StellarNet. Quick context and proposed internal agenda:
1) Validate the requested slab: spreadsheet asks for 8 A100-equivalent cards steady with 12k seq/day peak (see tab "ask").
2) Evaluate current spare pool across regions and candidate nodes that can be isolated (we should avoid carving from customers with committed SLAs this close to month start).
3) Recommend friction-minimizing option: segmented slab from a small reserve we keep for on-ramps (option A), or short-term burst from preemptible pool plus guaranteed fallback (option B).
4) Pricing/credit tradeoffs — Ben, can you have a range of credit/discounts we can offer if we commit guaranteed weeks?
5) Operational steps: change window, canary, KV cache warming, rollback triggers.

Prep: Karthik — bring a quick topology map and earliest time to provision. Laura — confirm who owns the runbook and attach gpu_rebalancing_runbook_v1.xlsx to the call. Ben — bring the commercial levers.

Thanks,
Priyom
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-09-22T09:35:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Urgent: StellarNet surge - need fast plan (internal)

All —

Outcome from ops review / provisioning feasibility:
- We can provision an isolated 8-card slab (A100-equivalent) in us-west within 48 hours if we take capacity from our short-term onramp reserve. That reserve currently holds 24 cards across three clusters.
- Risk profile: carving from reserve is low-risk. Carving from committed decks requires notifying/negotiating with existing Dedicated customers and could trigger SLA review — not acceptable before Oct 1.
- Preemption model: we will mark the slab as "time-limited reserved" (no preemption for the first 2 weeks, then preemptible with 24h notice in week 3+ if a higher-tier escalation arises).
- Operational checklist: KV cache preload, structured batching limits, and autoscale headroom set to 120% to handle burst. See attached runbook.

Recommendation (my call): Offer StellarNet the 8-card slab for Oct 1–Nov 12 (6 weeks) carved from onramp reserve. Require: signed amendment to SOW + 30% short-term rate uplift or equivalent service credits. Provide a canary window on day 2 with rollback trigger if we observe >5% error delta or latency >2x historical SLA.

If everyone agrees, I'll reserve the slab and schedule the provision window.

—Karthik
Head of Dedicated Sizing, Redwood Inference
Attachments: gpu_rebalancing_runbook_v1.xlsx
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Elaine Ford <elaine.ford@stellarnet.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-09-23T15:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Urgent: short-term capacity need for Q4 ramp — proposal

Elaine —

Thanks for the patience while we ran feasibility. Summary proposal:
- Redwood will allocate an 8-card segmented slab (A100-equivalent) in us-west for StellarNet from 2027-10-01 through 2027-11-12.
- Preemption policy: non-preemptible for the first 14 days; preemptible thereafter only under platform emergency with 24h notice and automatic fallback to a lower-cost shared fallback model.
- Commercials: 30% short-term uplift on the Dedicated rate card (SKU: DED-SLAB-ONRAMP) OR 20% uplift + one week of free onboarding credit; choice is yours.
- Operational safeguards: canary on day 2 with rollback triggers: >5% error increase or latency >2x; KV cache warm started ahead of first heavy traffic window.
- Required: signed amendment (we attached a DocuSign link) by 2027-09-26 11:59 PT to hit Oct 1 provisioning.

Next steps:
1) If you accept, sign the amendment here: https://docusign.com/EnvelopeID/9a8b7c6d
2) We'll provision hardware and share the canary schedule.
3) Ben will finalize commercial paperwork in HubSpot and confirm invoice timing.

Happy to hop on one more 20-min call if you want to walk the runbook.

Best,
Priyom Das
Sr. Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
